g.text: of the rimbilliton.akn Minecraft server in a
visual way with all the components and how they
single OCI Always Free ARM VM
running NixOS. Crafty Controller manages the Minecraft
server, its admin panel is protected by Pocket-ID SSO,
and world backups are shipped daily to Backblaze B2.

g.title: OIDC SSO provider (admin group only)
ACME certificate authority (HTTP-01)
Off-site backup bucket
DNS-only records mc and minecraft (no proxy)
Reverse proxy with automatic TLS for minecraft.chezmoi.sh
OIDC gate, only members of the admin group get through
Minecraft server manager (Podman container)
Game server created and managed from Crafty
Daily encrypted backups of Crafty archives and config
SSH and deployments, OCI SSH stays closed
